translations.web: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.
translations.bsb: Is any one of you suffering? He should pray. Is anyone cheerful? He should sing praises.
translations.kjv: Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any merry? let him sing psalms.
translations.asv: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praise.
